subject: Post-demo alignment & trial orchestration — integration milestones
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya@marketly.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo alignment & trial orchestration — integration milestones

Hi Priya — thanks again for the demo time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a clean kickoff for the trial:

1) Goal: validate Marketly’s end-to-end classification + reranking flow using Redwood streaming + function/tool calling for enriched metadata. Success criteria we discussed: stable p95 latency <200ms on representative requests, sustained 25-30 rps during peak synthetic load, and F1 >= 0.88 on your evaluation set.

2) Proposed trial window: 3 weeks (integration + ramp + acceptance).

3) Ownership:
- Account: Dylan Brooks (AM)
- Technical lead / SE: Neha Kapoor
- Engineering contact (if we need infra changes): Connor O'Brien

4) Immediate asks from Marketly for kickoff: security questionnaire, list of sample payloads, and a technical contact for streaming tests. I attached the deck and our standard PoC scope as a starting point.

Next step: can we lock a 60-minute kickoff on Mon 3/31 or Tue 4/1? If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and a short runbook for the first integration session.

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.

— Dylan
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
[dylan.brooks@redwood.ai]
[attachment: marketly_poc_scope.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Priya Singh <priya@marketly.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marketly AI - Evaluation Team <eval@marketly.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 18:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo alignment & trial orchestration — integration milestones

Thanks Dylan — really helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side before the kickoff:

- Security: attaching our filled security questionnaire (see Marketly_Security_Questionnaire.pdf). We will need explicit confirmation that we can keep inference traffic within us-west region and that logs for protected tokens are not persisted.

- Success criteria refinement: for the F1 target we’ll run your predictions against our gold set (10k examples). In addition to p95 we also want a p50 baseline and an error-rate graph across top-5 intents.

- Streaming / function calling: important that the trial exercise includes a streaming path (server-sent events preferred) and at least one tool call to our entity-resolution service (we demonstrated the flow in the demo). Can you confirm route names and auth method so our SRE can provision tokens?

- Kickoff: Tues 4/1 10:00am PT works for our team. Please send calendar invite with agenda and prework.

Priya
VP Product, Marketly
[attachment: Marketly_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (pdf)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya@marketly.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo alignment & trial orchestration — integration milestones

Hi Priya — great questions. Below is a concise POC plan with implementation details so your engineers can start provisioning: 

POC window & milestones (3 weeks)
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff, 3/30–4/1): security signoff, token generation, sample payload handoff.
- Week 1 (integration, 4/1–4/7): SDK wiring + streaming route test, function/tool call wiring to entity-resolution.
- Week 2 (ramp, 4/8–4/14): synthetic load + collection of latency/throughput metrics, run evaluation batch on 10k gold set.
- Week 3 (acceptance, 4/15–4/21): acceptance testing against success criteria and handoff to ops runbook.

Technical integration notes (quick reference)
- SDK: we recommend starting with Redwood JS SDK v2.1.0 (node-friendly streaming helpers). Repo + sample in shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-poc-docs
- Auth: short-lived API key per environment (instructions in the runbook). We support OAuth2 client-credentials as an alternative for long-lived CI agents.
- Routes: POST /v1/generate (batch), POST /v1/stream (SSE), WS wss://inference.redwood.ai/v1/streams (websocket fallback). For function/tool calling include tool metadata in the JSON envelope: {"tool_call": {"target":"entity-resolver","input_key":"id"}} — Neha will share a snippet in the kickoff.
- Metrics: built-in token-level latency breakdown, p50/p95/p99, token counts, and custom metric tags (customer_id, job_id). We’ll populate dashboards for the trial and grant your team viewer access.

Owners & contacts
- Dylan (AM) — commercial/contract questions
- Neha (SE) — integration runbook and SDK snippets
- Connor (Eng) — infra changes or custom kernel/quantization requests

Pre-kickoff asks for Marketly SRE
- Provide 3 representative JSON payloads (anonymized) and one high-volume sample stream (5–10k events).
- Confirm region constraint (us-west).
- Identify an SRE to accept the short-lived token and run streaming smoke tests (we will provide the script).

I will attach a short example of the SSE handshake and the tool-calling example in the calendar invite. Looking forward to the kickoff on 4/1 10:00am PT.

— Neha
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: sse_example.txt (txt)]

From: Priya Singh <priya@marketly.ai>

Perfect — thanks Neha. We've uploaded the three sample payloads to the Drive folder you shared and confirmed us-west region requirement. Our SRE (samir.kapoor@marketly.ai) will take the token handoff and perform the streaming smoke test during the kickoff.

We reviewed the acceptance criteria internally and confirm: p95 <200ms, sustain 30 rps, and F1 >=0.88 on the 10k gold set. If those gates are met we will sign off and move to a 6-month paid pilot.

Please send the calendar invite + runbook; we will complete the security questionnaire and return it today.

Regards,
Priya
